scope: structured skill-tag search only; no Bedrock routing, text relevance labels or ranking quality scores

gold_policy.source: independently iterate frozen MySQL snapshot, never derive truth from an arm search result
gold_policy.eligibility: same frozen clock, status and deadline policy across all arms
gold_policy.casefold: lowercase for all arms; no punctuation stripping, stemming, fuzzy matching or undeclared aliases
gold_policy.synonym_enabled: lowercase then map query and stored tags through the declared groups
gold_policy.AND: all skills_all match; no extra skill requirement from skills_any
gold_policy.OR: at least one skills_any matches; empty OR contributes no restriction
gold_policy.region: same explicit stored location substring policy across arms, no geographic inference
gold_policy.negative: verify token absent in frozen tags before assigning expected_count=0
gold_policy.zero: valid expected outcome; do not require every canonical to have a result
gold_policy.full_sets: fetch all result IDs via paging; do not compare only top 5
gold_policy.counts: not computed until a fixed snapshot is captured
